title: Reoxx Optimized
description: It works well for everyone, same graphics as always, comfortable and fast performance.
body:
t works well for everyone, same graphics as always, comfortable and fast performance. It has a performance similar to modpacks like Fabulously Optimized but with just the right mods.

It has classic mods like Sodium, Modern Fix and Entity Culling; it doesn't add new features but improves the gaming experience, meaning you use less RAM and triple the FPS.
